LanguageData.PM_Apex_DetectedText:
An APEX UAV has detected {1} raiders from {0}, approaching your colony over land.

Estimated arrival: {2}.

You can send a caravan to intercept them on the world map. Any casualties and injuries will persist if the survivors reach your colony.
LanguageData.PM_Apex_ArrivedText: The force tracked by APEX has reached your colony. {0} has {1} surviving raiders.
LanguageData.PM_Apex_DefeatedText: The raiding party from {0} has been defeated or driven off. This force will no longer attack your colony.
